history.summary: Large freehold 3BR (1,432sqft) at $1,563 PSF, 340m from Hillview MRT (DTL) in D23, priced right on the $1,569 URA median. Strong resale-only appreciation of 6.5%/yr on a credible 22-txn series, with a generous spread-out floorplate.
history.rating_rationale: Genuinely strong fundamentals for a value 3BR: freehold, 340m to Hillview MRT, $1,563 PSF at the URA median, and a clean resale-only 6.5%/yr CAGR backed by 22 transactions (not new-launch-biased). The $2.24M entry sits in a liquid family band. Caveat is age (1995, ~31yr) which lifts maintenance and slightly dampens resale velocity, but the large freehold floorplate near MRT is the durable appeal.
red_flags: Built 1995 (~31yr) — older fittings, higher maintenance, longer resale timeline
D23 Hillview is a quieter OCR sub-market with shallower buyer pool than RCR
catalysts: HillV2 / Rail Corridor / nature-fringe lifestyle draw
